item.title: Trump administration sues Coca-Cola distributor for alleged sex discrimination over event that excluded men
item.description: The EEOC sued Coca-Cola distributor for allegedly excluding male employees from a networking event, claiming a sex discrimination violation in workplace.

item.title: Top Dems Sanders and Reich ramp up billionaire tax push, say wealthy have ‘addiction’ to greed
item.description: Bernie Sanders and Robert Reich accuse America's "billionaire class" of greed "addiction" as they push for aggressive wealth taxes in blue states like New York and California.

item.title: Johnson & Johnson to invest $1B in Pennsylvania manufacturing facility
item.description: Johnson & Johnson announced a $1 billion investment in a Montgomery County, Pennsylvania, cell therapy facility that will yield over 500 manufacturing jobs plus 4,000 construction jobs.

item.title: O’Leary blasts California wealth tax as ‘bad management,’ calls on residents to 'hire' new leaders
item.description: Kevin O’Leary blasted California’s proposed 5% wealth tax as "bad management," urging residents to oust state leaders as lawmakers debate a measure that has drawn pushback

item.title: Trump admin ramps up effort to revive coal industry as power demand surges
item.description: The Trump administration is looking to extend the useful life of coal-fired power plants to boost the nation's energy security amid rising demand from AI data centers.

item.title: Elon Musk reveals price of Tesla's Cybercab
item.description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk confirmed the company will sell its fully autonomous Cybercab robotaxi for under $30,000 before 2027, as production officially begins.

item.title: Popular soda flavor returns as Keurig Dr Pepper rolls out 35 new drinks
item.description: Keurig Dr Pepper unveils over 35 new drinks including Dr Pepper Creamy Coconut, A&W Root Beer Float and 7UP Shirley Temple as beverage giant expands lineup.

item.title: Hundreds of NYC roles reportedly included in Amazon’s job reduction plan
item.description: Amazon reportedly laid off hundreds of New York employees in January as part of broader workforce cuts affecting thousands of workers across the company.

item.title: US businesses shift away from China under Trump tariffs
item.description: China's trade with U.S. midsize businesses plummeted 20% as Trump tariffs hit 37.4%, forcing companies to shift suppliers to Southeast Asia and beyond.

item.title: Silicon Valley engineers charged with stealing Google trade secrets and transferring them to Iran
item.description: Three Silicon Valley engineers arrested for allegedly stealing Google trade secrets and transferring sensitive data to Iran, federal prosecutors announced.
